classes: Android package, storage and preferences bridge
Android main Looper, HandlerThread and Choreographer bridge

imports: Android NDK window and media compatibility surface
bounded Unity 6 GLES3 and shader compatibility surface
SDL controller, OpenSL ES and AAudio providers

graphics_implementation.api: OpenGL ES 2.0 baseline with bounded Unity 6 GLES3 compatibility
graphics_implementation.egl_config: exact RGBA8888 with coherent real config attributes for Unity 2022.3.47f1 and Unity 6000.2.6f2
graphics_implementation.provider_selection: real GL vendor and renderer decide SDL ownership when a PowerVR firmware labels its SDL driver as mali
graphics_implementation.context_ownership: one real SDL context migrates between Unity main and graphics-worker threads
graphics_implementation.video_presenter: presenter-owned VAO with full Unity GL-state restoration

audio.format: FMOD-selected signed 16-bit PCM queued to SDL without port-side gain; Unity 6 AAudio uses the typed SDL bridge
audio.intro_path: opening movies finish through the native Unity callbacks without presentation by default; HD_PLAY_MOVIES=1 retains the external decoder for diagnostics
audio.volume_policy: speaker and mixer volume remain firmware/user controlled

input.mapping: firmware/PortMaster SDL mapping first, canonical legacy ordinal correction only for external USB/Bluetooth BTN_C/BTN_Z controllers (never BUS_HOST/I2C/SPI), then semantic SDL GameController state at the profile-selected Huntdown GamePad methods; R2 and R3 feed the live B9 dash slot, and R2 never feeds Fire
input.menu_mapping: A confirms, B cancels, X/Y remain auxiliary menu actions
input.touch: not required for the validated controller flow
input.terminal_combo: Back+Start requests native focus-loss and pause

persistence.full_game_entitlement: profile-selected exact-signature LocalStorage.IsPayed bridge for either validated complete owner payload

terminal.action: focus loss and native pause precede bounded adapter shutdown

quirks.selector: pinned FMOD wrapper and error 33 only
quirks.effect: retry the same sound without CREATESTREAM

quirks.selector: unsupported ETC2 RGBA8 upload for the pinned texture set
quirks.effect: decode only the required textures to RGBA8
prepend the compatibility directory only in movie-decoder children

quirks.selector: one correlated Huntdown 200023 or 200036 libil2cpp payload and its exact LocalStorage.IsPayed signature
quirks.effect: preserve the complete owner copy when Android Unity IAP restoration is unavailable

quirks.selector: supported Unity EGL minimum-spec enumeration on an SDL-owned backend
quirks.effect: select an exact real RGBA8888 window+pbuffer configuration instead of the first RGBX candidate

quirks.selector: SDL reports mali but the real GL vendor/renderer is not ARM Mali
quirks.effect: keep the PowerVR context under SDL ownership instead of using raw Mali EGL objects
defer Unity and IL2CPP initialization until the registered NativeLoader requests each module

quirks.selector: ReflectionHelper Runnable proxy created by the correlated Unity 6 profile
quirks.effect: dispatch through nativeProxyInvoke and isolate callback JNI exception state

quirks.selector: correlated Huntdown 200036 profile on a fbdev driver that rejects the native Unity 6 GLES3 contract
quirks.effect: retry EGL as physical ES2, expose only the bounded GLES3 contract to Unity, prefer measured emulation over unusable dispatch thunks, and repack GLES3 texture uploads at the physical API boundary

prohibitions: do not reorder or skip the guest lifecycle
do not expose the ffmpeg-only loader stub to Unity or the launcher
do not force global NPOT texture wrap
do not add port-side audio gain without separate physical evidence
do not package owner-supplied Android data
do not claim an untested physical device family
